component.name: Glance
component.summary: View and edit PDFs, images, camera RAW and 3D models

description.p: Glance brings the everyday tools of macOS Preview to Linux in a small, fast app. Free and open source, it needs no account and collects no telemetry. Saved signatures and AI API keys stay in your login keyring.

Read PDFs in continuous, single or two-page view. Rearrange, rotate, delete and insert pages by dragging; merge documents between tabs or drag pages out to make a new PDF. Fill in forms, sign with your mouse, pen or a photo, and add highlights, notes, shapes, arrows and text boxes that stay editable in other PDF apps. Redaction removes content, not just a black box on top. Clean Up PDF strips comments, metadata, attachments and scripts. Export with an AES-256 password, reduce file size, or save pages as PNG, JPEG or TIFF.

Open HEIC, camera RAW, JPEG XL, WebP, AVIF, PSD, TIFF and dozens more image formats. Adjust color, resize, crop, remove backgrounds with on-device AI, mark up screenshots, remove location info, make collages and batch-convert images.
View GLB/glTF, OBJ, STL, 3MF, FBX, USDZ and more 3D models with orbit, wireframe and snapshots. Edits save automatically, and every save keeps a version you can go back to.
